official: 八王子市斎場条例の一部を改正する条例設定について
committee: 予算等審査特別委員会
name: 斎場の式場・夜間付添い・霊安室の使用料を改定
summary: 現在、第1式場は1回あたり市内25,000円・市外50,000円、通夜終了後の夜間付添いは1回あたり市内10,000円・市外20,000円です。議案では、それぞれ市内30,000円・市外60,000円、市内15,000円・市外30,000円にし、霊安室は市外利用者の1棺24時間以内の料金を6,000円から10,000円にします。改定額は令和9年4月1日から適用されますが、それ以後の利用には同日より前でも改定額を徴収できるとしています。
changes: 第1式場の通夜・告別式の使用料を市内25,000円・市外50,000円から、市内30,000円・市外60,000円に上げる
通夜終了後の夜間付添い料金を市内10,000円・市外20,000円から、市内15,000円・市外30,000円に上げる
霊安室の市外料金を1棺24時間以内6,000円から10,000円に上げる
who: 八王子市斎場の第1式場を利用する人
通夜終了後に式場で夜間の付添いをする人
市外利用者として霊安室を利用する人

en.name: Raises fees for the ceremony room, overnight attendance, and mortuary use at the funeral hall
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Hachioji City Funeral Hall Ordinance
en.summary: The current fee for Ceremony Room 1 is ¥25,000 per use for Hachioji City residents and ¥50,000 for people from outside the city. Overnight attendance after the wake ends currently costs ¥10,000 per use for Hachioji City residents and ¥20,000 for people from outside the city. The bill raises these fees to ¥30,000 and ¥60,000 for the ceremony room, and ¥15,000 and ¥30,000 for overnight attendance, respectively. It also raises the fee for outside-city users of the mortuary room, for one casket for up to 24 hours, from ¥6,000 to ¥10,000. The new fees apply from April 1, 2027. The bill also allows the new fees to be charged before that date for use taking place on or after that date.
changes: Raises the fee for Ceremony Room 1 from ¥25,000 to ¥30,000 for Hachioji City residents and from ¥50,000 to ¥60,000 for people from outside the city
Raises the overnight attendance fee after the wake from ¥10,000 to ¥15,000 for Hachioji City residents and from ¥20,000 to ¥30,000 for people from outside the city
Raises the mortuary room fee for outside-city users, for one casket for up to 24 hours, from ¥6,000 to ¥10,000
who: People using Ceremony Room 1 at Hachioji City Funeral Hall
People accompanying the deceased overnight at the ceremony hall after the wake ends
People from outside Hachioji City using the mortuary room
